items.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was with Steve Kuhn’s group. I recorded several things on ECM with Steve Kuhn... We were friends but I don‟t, you know, obviously he thought I could add something to it.

ctx.x: But uh, I love teaching. I get the same… if I‟m teaching good, if I feel, um, it‟s happening, I get the same feeling that I do if I‟m singing and we‟re connecting like with Cameron or if I‟m working with Steve Kuhn or whoever I‟m working with. If we‟re connecting, it‟s the same feeling if I‟m teaching. I have that same desire and that same thrill that I get, you know. And uh, the one thing I don‟t like to do is I don‟t like to teach the same day I sing, because emotionally, I‟m wrung out from teaching, you know.…
